description: List the package manager's currently running services as seen by the invoking (non-root) user. The adapter issues the service-listing command, splits the raw multi-line output into individual service names, and drops blank lines (no de-duplication is applied to this single listing). If the listing command exits with an error, a neutral 'services check failed' error is reported. The output echoes the issued listing command followed by one line per running service, in order; blank entries are omitted.

cases.expected_output: cmd=brew services list | grep started | awk '{ print $1; }'

cmd=brew services list | grep started | awk '{ print $1; }'
service=onlyservice

cmd=brew services list | grep started | awk '{ print $1; }'
service=alpha
service=alpha
service=beta

cmd=brew services list | grep started | awk '{ print $1; }'
service=mysql
service=redis
